scope: Korean written discourse construction and data collection, not generic judge optimization or human naturalness certification
observations: An existential singleton selected from 2 cups has an identifiable source group but not a known individual physical identity.
The 'other cup' as complement of 1 chosen from 2 has cardinality 1 but still no physically identified member.
Selecting 1 from 3 books leaves 2 others; these are a set complement, not one unique book.
Two simultaneously accessible groups of the same Korean nominal kind make unqualified 그중 ambiguous and are rejected.
Finite-to-고 generation is restricted to source-attested small dictionary; no general Korean morphological model.

data_provenance.old_legacy_research: KSGT G9-P36-R10 NIKL ZA source and ontology census already exists: no false claim of first collection.
data_provenance.basis: Original authenticated Drive archive analyzed in local runtime; corpus raw bytes not committed to public GitHub. 2025 ontology is not directly partitive coreference gold.
data_provenance.private_data_limitations: NIKL rights must be respected; not republished as training gold or open GitHub plaintext.

scientific_limits: Controlled sources were authored by the assistant and not independent native-writing samples.
Zero-anaphora corpus annotates omitted arguments, not partitive anaphora antecedents.
Preserved internal source roles and counts do not prove natural prose quality.
External corpora discovery does not equal authorized raw data acquisition; imported original NIKL data already existed in user Drive.
Past KRC v0.1 human preference samples remain withdrawn as invalid.
next_stage: KRC v0.7 prospective: sample independent naturally written Korean partitives with antecedent/group span labels and test competing candidate groups and discourse accessibility, optionally compare with public KoCoNovel/GOLEM only for annotated relations they actually carry.
